messages:
deploy-bot: Canary started: release/2026.03.22-hotpatch-2 (e5f7c) -> prod/us-west-3. Canary 8% now. Running post-deploy smoke and synthetic probes.

Rae: Quick heads-up: smokeprobe queue-jitter metric for /v1/chat in us-west-3 showed intermittent spikes, p95 jumped to ~900ms from baseline ~240ms across probes. No widespread 5xx yet. cc @Ibrahim

Ibrahim: Thanks. Any correlation by session affinity or long-running connections?

Cooper: Looking at probe logs — spikes correlate with probes that include multi-turn context rebuilds (session rehydrate). A few probes show a delayed shard load on canary nodes.

Rae: Sounds like cold-shard or prefill regression. Two mitigation options: pin route to previous variant `chat-stable-20260310` or enable aggressive prefill on canary pool. Prefer pin first, then prefill.

Ibrahim: Agreed. Pin route in region and set a short duration while we triage. Cooper, can you run the pin?

Cooper: Running: 
```
rbctl pin-route --region=us-west-3 --service=chat --to=model:chat-stable-20260310 --duration=60m --reason="postdeploy smokequeue jitter"
```

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Cooper at 1812345692. Duration=60m. Telemetry: https://internal.redwood/obs/canary/1812345670

Cooper: After pin, reran 1k synthetic requests: pinned p95=260ms, canary variant p95=890ms. No 502s reproduced in the A/B.

Rae: Good. Pause rollout at current percent (8%). Also enable prefill on canary pool to rule out cold-starts: `rbctl pool-update --region=us-west-3 --pool=canary --set=prefill=true`

Ibrahim: I'm enabling a circuit-breaker too: if proxy 5xx > 0.3% for 3m -> divert to cpu-fallback and page oncall.

ops-bot: ops-bot: circuit-breaker rule created by Ibrahim at 1812345710 (threshold=0.3% window=180s).

Rae: Updating release notes: "us-west-3: canary paused at 8% due to smokeprobe queue-jitter on /v1/chat. Route pinned to chat-stable-20260310; prefill enabled; circuit-breaker added. Watch 45m."

Cooper: Will collect shard-load timing and KV cache hit/miss stats from canary nodes and drop into INF-7012. If pin+prefill resolves, we'll keep paused until ML/runtime team confirms fix.

infra-bot: infra-bot: canary paused at 8% by operator action. To resume: `deploy resume --region=us-west-3 --percent=25`. To revert: `deploy revert --to=release/2026.03.19`.

Rae: Thanks everyone. Standby for watch updates; will escalate if alerts fire. :eyes:
